claims.text: Tracing gives visibility into agent/app activity; evaluations measure performance against curated test cases; Signals score agent turns and apply tags/ratings to surface problems.

Weave gives visibility into agent sessions/multi-turn conversations or individual function calls. Agent traces appear on the Agents page and weave.op calls on the Traces page. Both can be used in one project but produce separate traces.

Evaluations define metrics with scoring functions, compare evaluations across metrics and samples, track which model and prompt versions produced which performance, and benchmark and monitor performance.

The Signals tab in the Agents view shows tags and ratings for agent conversations. It flags quality and safety problems such as low-quality responses, frustrated users and NSFW content, and highlights traces that need attention.
